review_evidence: README identifies PosCheck as a pattern-oriented symbolic model checker with compositional verification, unification, and dynamically generated proof obligations.
pretheorem.lean defines State, Pattern, Rule, postImage and mapsInto semantics and proves Pattern.disjunction_assoc, Rule.disjunction_assoc, and mapsInto_iff_postImage_subset.

The same source proves exact post-image and sound-overapproximation results in worked transition-system examples, providing formal semantics and verification content rather than only implementation machinery.
summary: Retain DMC-Logic: it formalizes pattern/rule semantics and proofs supporting symbolic model checking and constrained pattern narrowing.
